title: Restaurant Review Analysis Report
executive_summary: Analysis of 14 customer reviews for Kokomos Bar & Grille reveals primary concerns regarding inconsistent food quality and a perception of poor value for money. Key recommendations include standardizing food preparation and ingredient sourcing to improve quality, followed by a strategic review of pricing and value propositions to better align with customer expectations.
key_findings: Customers frequently report issues with the quality of the food, indicating dissatisfaction with taste, preparation, or ingredients.
There are recurring complaints about the pricing being too high or not offering good value for money.

root_causes.pattern: Customers frequently report issues with the quality of the food, indicating dissatisfaction with taste, preparation, or ingredients.
root_causes.cause: Inconsistent food preparation or ingredient sourcing, leading to varying quality of dishes.

root_causes.pattern: There are recurring complaints about the pricing being too high or not offering good value for money.
root_causes.cause: Pricing strategy is not aligned with customer perception of value, especially when combined with food quality issues.

recommendations.issue: Inconsistent food quality due to varying preparation and ingredient sourcing.
recommendations.action: Develop and strictly enforce detailed, standardized recipes and cooking procedures for all menu items. Implement a daily chef's tasting panel for quality control before service, and establish a robust supplier vetting process with clear quality specifications for all incoming ingredients.
recommendations.expected_impact: Significant improvement in dish consistency and overall food quality, directly addressing customer dissatisfaction and building trust, which is foundational for value perception.

recommendations.issue: Customer perception that pricing is too high or does not offer good value, exacerbated by food quality issues.
recommendations.action: Once food quality consistency is established (from Priority 1 action), conduct a comprehensive menu engineering analysis to identify high-profit, high-popularity items and adjust pricing or portion sizes strategically. Consider introducing value-focused promotions or combo deals to enhance perceived value without necessarily lowering base prices.
recommendations.expected_impact: Improved customer perception of value for money, potentially leading to increased sales and reduced complaints about pricing, especially once food quality is consistently high.

limitations: The analysis is based on a small sample size of 14 reviews, which may not fully represent the entire customer experience or broader trends.
Review data is subjective and may not always provide specific actionable details without further investigation.
